meta.range: 2026-09-19 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (data exists from 2026-09-19 10:52 UTC; PostHog was installed that day)
meta.human_filter: sessions with >=1 $pageview, no event with $virt_is_bot = true, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app (unless a query says otherwise)
meta.caveat: Test-account cohort 580233 has 0 members, so team traffic is included (about 48 sessions from 4 devices with 10+ sessions each, Q24). Aggregates only.

queries.what: p75 web vitals per page and device (pages with at least 5 samples across LCP, INP and CLS)
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$host AS host, multiIf(properties.$pathname = '/', '/', properties.$pathname LIKE '/products/kheelu%', '/products/kheelu', properties.$pathname LIKE '/stories/%', '/stories/*', properties.$pathname) AS page, properties.$device_type AS device, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS lcp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS lcp_p75_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS fcp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS fcp_p75_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS inp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value), properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS inp_p75_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS cls_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value), properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL), 3) AS cls_p75 FROM events WHERE event = '$web_vitals' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND coalesce(properties.$virt_is_bot, false) = false AND properties.$device_type IN ('Mobile','Desktop') GROUP BY host, page, device HAVING lcp_n + inp_n + cls_n >= 5 ORDER BY host, lcp_n DESC LIMIT 40

queries.what: p75 web vitals per host and device (all pages)
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$host AS host, properties.$device_type AS device, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS lcp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS lcp_p75_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS inp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value), properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS inp_p75_ms, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS cls_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value), properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL), 3) AS cls_p75, countIf(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS fcp_n, round(quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value), properties.$web_vitals_FCP_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS fcp_p75_ms FROM events WHERE event = '$web_vitals' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND coalesce(properties.$virt_is_bot, false) = false AND properties.$device_type IN ('Mobile','Desktop') GROUP BY host, device ORDER BY host, device

queries.what: Captured exceptions by page, device, browser and message
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$host AS host, properties.$pathname AS path, properties.$device_type AS device, properties.$browser AS browser, left(arrayStringConcat(JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(toString(properties.$exception_types), '[]')), ','), 40) AS types, left(arrayStringConcat(JSONExtractArrayRaw(coalesce(toString(properties.$exception_values), '[]')), ' | '), 160) AS vals, count() AS n, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions, min(toDate(timestamp)) AS first_day, max(toDate(timestamp)) AS last_day FROM events WHERE event = '$exception' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY host, path, device, browser, types, vals ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 40
